dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete expert details not usually known to a generic model: specific replica‑lag threshold (30 s), exact pre‑check priority order, timing baselines for automatic vs. planned failover, recent feature changes (2024‑2026), and nuanced global‑DB split‑brain risks. Deductions for occasional over‑generalizations (e.g., “RDS Proxy always survives failover”) and lack of explicit IAM permission handling.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes AWS‑specific procedure flow: ordered pre‑checks, exact CLI commands with flags, CONFIRM gate, wait commands, post‑verification steps, and special handling for global DB and failback. One point deducted for a few generic health‑check mentions that could be more AWS‑specific.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Robust NEVER list with concrete pitfalls (no healthy reader, Global DB misuse, DNS cache, split‑brain, proxy misuse) and clear reasoning for each. One point deducted for missing anti‑patterns around IAM permissions and snapshot‑based recovery edge cases.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete, description, when‑to‑use, activation triggers, schema, and example are all present. The only minor gap is the absence of a dedicated "activation_conditions" field; activation_triggers serve the purpose but the spec expects a clearer boolean condition.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered well (quick reference → mindset → process → anti‑patterns). Some sections (e.g., the full pre‑flight checklist) are dense, causing a slight cognitive overload for first‑time readers.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive operations are tightly constrained: mandatory CONFIRM gate, exhaustive pre‑checks, BLOCKED/READY/COMPLETED states, and explicit safety warnings. Creative tasks (planning) are given appropriate flexibility.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a coherent, recognizable pattern (overview → mindset → pre‑flight → process → output contract → heuristics → anti‑patterns), matching established skill structures.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides actionable CLI steps, decision tree, and worked examples, enabling an agent to execute. Deductions for inconsistencies: verdict_shape lists only READY|BLOCKED|COMPLETED but the text mentions a VERDICT: ERROR; missing explicit error handling and rollback guidance; limited guidance on handling CLI failures or IAM permission errors.
